page.overview:
Who is Ispan Shefar?

Ispan Shefar was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, and secretly of the Black Ajah.

Ispan was a Taraboner with black hair in a multitude of braids with blue and green beads after the Taraboner fashion.

Ispan was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of the series.

She was 109 years old when she died. She was born in and went to the White Tower in the series. After spending six years as a novice and eight years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 922 NE.
